location.en: A bench outside the language school

goal.en: Comfort Leo after a failed exam, without lecturing.
goal.zh: 在里歐考試失利後安慰他，不說教。

background: quiet bench under a large tree outside a brick school building, fallen leaves on the path, empty bike rack nearby, soft late afternoon light

intro.en: Monday afternoon. Leo's exam results came out an hour ago, and he hasn't answered anyone's messages.
intro.zh: 星期一下午。里歐的考試成績一小時前公布了，他誰的訊息都沒回。

intro.en: You find him alone on the bench outside school, staring at his phone.
intro.zh: 你在學校外的長椅上找到他，他一個人盯著手機發呆。

lines.en: I failed. The certification exam. I needed a 70, and I got a 62.
lines.zh: 我沒過。檢定考。我需要 70 分，結果只拿到 62。

choices.en: Oh, Leo. That must be tough, especially after all that studying.
choices.zh: 喔，里歐。一定很難受，尤其你念了那麼久。
choices.tip: That must be tough. 先承認對方的難受，是安慰的第一句。

choices.en: Well, 62 isn't bad. You should've studied more grammar, though.
choices.zh: 嗯，62 分不算差啦。不過你應該多念點文法的。

lines.en: Thanks, coach. I'll put that on my list of regrets.
lines.zh: 謝謝教練。我會把它加進我的後悔清單。

story.en: Leo puts his headphones on. You've turned a hug moment into a grammar review session.
story.zh: 里歐戴上耳機。你把一個該擁抱的時刻，變成了文法檢討會。

fail.why: 對方剛失敗時馬上檢討原因，聽起來像在說教。先同理：That must be tough.，建議等對方準備好再說。

choices.en: Aiya, so pity! Never mind, next time you just add oil more, okay?
choices.zh: 哎呀，好可惜！沒關係，下次再多加油就好，好嗎？

lines.en: Add oil? Like... to a car? And "so pity"?
lines.zh: 加油？像是……幫車子加油？還有 so pity 是什麼？

story.en: Leo is too confused to stay sad, which is almost a success. Almost.
story.zh: 里歐困惑到忘記難過，這幾乎算是成功了。幾乎。

fail.why: 「好可惜」是 That's a shame. 或 That's too bad.，不是 so pity。「加油」直譯 add oil 多數人聽不懂，安慰時可以說 That must be tough.。

lines.en: I studied every night for two months. And I still wasn't good enough.
lines.zh: 我每天晚上都在念，念了兩個月。結果還是不夠好。

choices.en: You worked so hard. One score doesn't change that, Leo.
choices.zh: 你真的很努力。一個分數改變不了這件事，里歐。
choices.tip: 肯定對方的努力，把「分數」和「這個人」分開，是不說教的安慰。

choices.en: You worked so hard. One score doesn't mean you're not enough good.
choices.zh: 你很努力了。一個分數不代表你不夠好。

lines.en: "Not enough good"? Great, now I'm worried about YOUR grammar too.
lines.zh: Not enough good？很好，現在我連你的文法都要擔心了。

story.en: Leo spends the next five minutes explaining word order to you. It distracts him, but it doesn't exactly comfort him.
story.zh: 里歐花了五分鐘跟你解釋字序。他是分心了，但不算被安慰到。

fail.why: enough 修飾形容詞時要放在形容詞後面：good enough，不是 enough good。

choices.en: At least it wasn't as bad as my cousin. My cousin got a 50!
choices.zh: 至少沒有我表哥慘啦。我表哥考 50 分耶！

lines.en: ...Is that supposed to make me feel better?
lines.zh: ……這樣講是要讓我好過一點嗎？

story.en: Now Leo feels bad, and your cousin is somehow involved. Nobody wins this one.
story.zh: 現在里歐心情很差，你表哥還莫名被拖下水。這局沒有贏家。

fail.why: 用「別人更慘」來安慰，在英語文化中常讓人覺得自己的感受被比下去了。專注在對方身上：You worked so hard.。

lines.en: My parents are going to be so disappointed. I don't even know how to tell them.
lines.zh: 我爸媽一定會很失望。我連要怎麼跟他們說都不知道。

choices.en: You don't have to figure that out tonight. I'm here for you.
choices.zh: 你不用今晚就想好。我會陪著你。
choices.tip: I'm here for you. 是「我會陪你」最自然的說法，不給建議也很有力量。

choices.en: Parents, right? My mom asks me every single day when I'm coming home.
choices.zh: 爸媽就是這樣嘛。我媽每天都問我什麼時候回家。

lines.en: ...Right. Sorry, I guess this is about your mom now.
lines.zh: ……是喔。抱歉，看來現在要聊你媽了。

story.en: You talk about your mom for ten minutes. Leo nods. Leo is still sad, now with extra information about your family.
story.zh: 你講了十分鐘你媽的事。里歐點頭聽著，依然很難過，只是多知道了你家的事。

fail.why: 對方在傾訴時把話題拉回自己身上，會讓人覺得沒被聽見。把焦點留在對方：I'm here for you.。

choices.en: Just tell them directly. Being scared won't solve anything, you know.
choices.zh: 就直接跟他們說啊。害怕也解決不了問題。

lines.en: Wow. Thanks for the life lesson.

story.en: You're technically right. That's the problem. Leo goes home early and doesn't call his parents either.
story.zh: 你說的技術上沒錯，這正是問題所在。里歐提早回家，也沒打給爸媽。

fail.why: 「害怕沒用」是對的道理，但在對方脆弱時說，聽起來像責備。先陪伴，不急著解決：You don't have to figure that out tonight.。

lines.en: Thanks. I just... I don't want advice right now, you know? I just feel stupid.
lines.zh: 謝啦。我只是……現在不想聽建議，你懂嗎？我只覺得自己很笨。

choices.en: Got it. No advice. Want to just sit here together for a while?
choices.zh: 了解，不給建議。要不要就在這裡一起坐一下？
choices.tip: 對方說不要建議，就尊重他。安靜陪伴（sit here together）有時比任何話都有用。

choices.en: Okay, but here's a plan: retake it in March and use flashcards.
choices.zh: 好，但我有個計畫：三月重考，然後用單字卡。

lines.en: Kai. I literally just said no advice.

story.en: Your plan is actually good. Leo will appreciate it in about three weeks. Tonight, he just walks away.
story.zh: 你的計畫其實不錯，里歐大概三週後會感激你。但今晚，他直接走掉了。

fail.why: 對方明說 I don't want advice.，還硬要給建議會讓人覺得不被尊重。回應對方需要的：Got it. No advice.。

choices.en: Got it, no advice. Do you want to just sitting here for a while?
choices.zh: 了解，不給建議。你想在這裡坐一下嗎？

lines.en: "Want to sitting"? Okay, now I feel a little less stupid.
lines.zh: Want to sitting？好吧，我現在覺得自己沒那麼笨了。

story.en: Your grammar mistake makes Leo feel smarter. It's not the comfort you planned, but he does crack a small grin.
story.zh: 你的文法錯誤讓里歐覺得自己比較聰明。不是你計畫中的安慰，但他確實嘴角上揚了一下。

fail.why: want to 後面接原形動詞：Do you want to just sit here?。不定詞 to 後面不加 -ing。

lines.en: You sit together in silence. The sky slowly turns orange.
lines.zh: 你們安靜地坐在一起。天空慢慢染成橘色。

lines.en: Thanks for not making it weird, Kai. Can we get dumplings? I'm suddenly starving.
lines.zh: 謝謝你沒把氣氛搞尷尬，凱。我們去吃水餃好不好？我突然好餓。

choices.en: Absolutely. Dumplings are on me. That's what friends are for.
choices.zh: 當然。水餃我請，朋友就是這樣。
choices.tip: That's what friends are for. 是「朋友就是要互相幫忙」，溫暖又不肉麻。

choices.en: Dumplings? You just failed, and you're already thinking about food?
choices.zh: 水餃？你才剛考砸，就已經在想吃的了？

lines.en: Wow. Okay. Forget it. I'll eat alone.
lines.zh: 哇。好喔。算了，我自己去吃。

story.en: You meant it as a joke. Leo did not hear it as a joke. You eat dumplings alone, too, at a different shop.
story.zh: 你本來只是開玩笑，但里歐聽起來一點都不好笑。你也一個人去吃水餃，在另一家店。

fail.why: 對方情緒剛好轉時拿失敗開玩笑，很容易被誤解成嘲諷。順著對方的提議走：Absolutely. Dumplings are on me.。

choices.en: Okay! Eat full, sleep full, and everything will pass, you'll see.
choices.zh: 好！吃飽睡飽，一切都會過去的，你看著吧。

lines.en: Eat full? Sleep full? Is that a fortune cookie?
lines.zh: 吃滿？睡滿？這是籤餅上的句子嗎？

story.en: Leo laughs and says it should be printed on a T-shirt. He still has no idea what you meant.
story.zh: 里歐笑說這句應該印在 T 恤上。不過他還是不懂你的意思。

fail.why: 「吃飽睡飽」直譯成 eat full, sleep full 不是英文說法。可以說 Get some food and some rest. Things will get better.。

lines.en: Deal. And next time, I'm passing that thing.
lines.zh: 成交。還有，下次我一定要考過。

lines.en: Over a plate of dumplings, Leo laughs for the first time that day.
lines.zh: 一盤水餃下肚，里歐今天第一次笑了。

story.en: You didn't fix anything, and you didn't need to. Sometimes being there is the whole job.
story.zh: 你什麼都沒解決，也不需要解決。有時候，陪在身邊就是全部。

notes.explain: must 表示合理推測。用來承認對方的難處，是英文安慰的第一句。也可以說 That must be hard.。

example.en: You lost your job? That must be tough.
example.zh: 你丟了工作？那一定很難受。

notes.explain: 表示「我在你身邊，需要時找我」。不給建議，只表達支持，對難過的人往往最有用。

example.en: Call me anytime. I'm here for you.

notes.explain: enough 修飾形容詞時放在後面（good enough、old enough）；修飾名詞時放在前面（enough time、enough money）。

example.en: Your English is good enough for the job.
example.zh: 你的英文程度足以勝任這份工作。

notes.en: That's a shame. / That's too bad.
notes.explain: 「好可惜」不能說 so pity。pity 通常用在 What a pity. 或 It's a pity that...。加油直譯 add oil 也容易讓人聽不懂。

example.en: You missed the concert? That's a shame.
example.zh: 你錯過演唱會了？好可惜。

notes.en: Do you want advice, or should I just listen?
notes.zh: 你想聽建議，還是我聽你說就好？
notes.explain: 英語文化中，安慰時常先問對方需要什麼。不比較、不說教、不急著解決問題，尊重對方的節奏。

example.en: That sounds hard. Do you want advice, or should I just listen?
example.zh: 聽起來很辛苦。你想聽建議，還是我聽你說就好？
